metadataReview.note: Add a town-level reference for the Prussian assault on Swedish-held Fehrbellin, identified as the battle of 28 September 1758 by the Swedish state museums’ KulturNav authority. The point is the town, not a gate or bridge position. The existing date is retained. Numbers in the secondary article are not adopted. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: The OpenStreetMap place node for the town of Fehrbellin (node 240064305, place=town, the place linked to the municipal boundary in Nominatim) gives latitude 52.8142217 and longitude 12.7652143, rounded to [12.7652,52.8142]. The Swedish state museums’ KulturNav authority identifies the battle as fought at Fehrbellin; the cited Wikipedia revision, used only as a secondary pointer, describes a storming of the town at its gates, streets and Rhin bridge. This is a town-centre reference, not the western gate, the bridge or any unit position. No accuracy radius is claimed.
